spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of sparse grass against a plain light background. It has the overall body shape, head, and limbs of a horse but is almost entirely armored with overlapping pangolin-like scales. The body is stout and horse-proportioned with a long neck, deep chest, and rounded hindquarters. The head is dark brown and horse-like with an elongated muzzle, large nostril, dark eye, and upright ears, mostly covered in short hair except for a cap of scales on the forehead. From the top of the neck along the back, sides, hindquarters, upper legs, and the full length of the long tapering tail, the skin is covered in dense, large, overlapping rounded scales in shades of dark brown and tan with lighter edges. The lower portions of the four legs below the scale coverage show dark brown hair and end in hooves, and the underbelly and chest show lighter tan hair between the scaled areas.

meta_spark.description: A horse-sized quadruped stands in right-facing profile on a small patch of grass. It has the overall shape, head, neck, torso, slender legs and single-toed hooves of a dark brown horse, but its upper surfaces are covered in dense overlapping large brown scales. The scaled armor covers the crown of the head, the crest and sides of the neck, the back and flanks, the upper portions of all four legs, and continues onto a long narrow tapering tail that hangs down behind. The face, underside of the neck, pale underbelly, and lower legs below the scales show short horse-like fur.
